I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent averages.

As of the most recent data I’ve seen (late‑2025), the USD/GBP rate has been hovering around **0.77 – 0.78 GBP per 1 USD**. Using a mid‑point of 0.775 GBP/USD:

\[
\$20 \times 0.775 \;=\; £15.50
\]

So roughly **$20 ≈ £15.50**.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly due to market conditions, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly depending on when you convert the money and which bank or service you use. If you need a precise, up‑to‑date quote, it’s best to check with your bank, a currency‑exchange website, or a financial app that provides live rates.
